description: This Java source file defines an Android Fragment called DrawableTintingFragment, which provides a user interface for programmatically applying color tinting and blend modes to a drawable image. It includes UI elements such as SeekBars for ARGB color components and a Spinner for selecting PorterDuff blend modes, allowing users to modify the tint in real-time. The file manages state restoration, user interactions, and applies color filters to the ImageView based on user input.

classes.name: DrawableTintingFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that provides an interactive UI to apply tinting and blend modes to a drawable image, enabling dynamic color adjustments and mode selection.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and enables options menu.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes UI components, restores state if available, and sets up event listeners for UI interactions.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current UI state such as selected blend mode and color component sliders.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Calculates and returns the ARGB color based on SeekBar positions.

methods.name: getTintMode
methods.description: Returns the currently selected PorterDuff blend mode.

methods.name: updateTint
methods.description: Applies the selected color filter and blend mode to the ImageView and updates UI labels with current ARGB values.
